Title: Generally available: Azure Monitor alerts now suggests signals to alert on

Body.Content:
When creating an alert rule using the Azure portal, configuring the condition of the alert rule is now made simpler. Instead of needing to sift through dozens of available signals, you will now be able to choose from a short list of popular signals. In addition, if you select a popular signal that also has a popular condition commonly configured, the condition fields will be automatically populated for you (you can always tweak them to your needs).

Read our documentation to learn more.
